note: Hand-written realistic RTL faults for the bug benchmark (nnc bench). Each replaces one line of rtl/; the delivered RTL is never changed. 'expect' is the correct triage verdict.

bugs.title: WLAST one beat early in an aggregated write burst (never raised for a one-beat burst)
bugs.spec: AXI WLAST on the final beat of the burst (AWLEN = beats - 1)

bugs.title: read DECERR returned as AHB OKAY
bugs.spec: REQ-ERR-001: SLVERR, DECERR and EXOKAY map to the AHB two-cycle ERROR

bugs.title: word alignment checks only address bit 0
bugs.spec: REQ-ERR-002: a misaligned transfer returns AHB ERROR with no AXI request
